title: Ab initio LAPW total energy calculations
action: Perform first-principles full-potential LAPW calculations for Cu, Ta, Mo, Pt, and Au over a range of atomic volumes to obtain the 0 K total energy E_c(V). Use GGA for Cu, Ta, Mo and LDA for Pt, Au.
description: Intermediary 0 K total energy curves E_c(V) for each metal, stored as JSON.
output_schema: JSON object mapping element name to arrays of volumes and energies.

title: Mean-field potential Hugoniot and 300 K isotherm calculation
action: From the computed E_c(V), implement the MFP definition g(r,V) = ½[E_c(R+r)+E_c(R-r)−2E_c(R)] to calculate the ionic vibrational free energy F_ion(V,T) and electronic free energy F_el(V,T). Solve for pressure and temperature along the principal Hugoniot to obtain MFP‑predicted reduced volumes X_sw^MFP(P) and the 300 K isotherm X_300^MFP(P) for each metal over the pressure range up to ~1000 GPa.
description: Intermediary MFP reduced volumes X_sw^MFP(P) and X_300^MFP(P) for each metal.
output_schema: JSON mapping element name to lists of pressure-reduced volume pairs.

title: Shock-reduced 300 K isotherm data points
action: Using the provided experimental D-u coefficients, compute X_sw^ex(P) via the Rankine‑Hugoniot relations. Apply the reduction formula X_300^rd(P) = X_sw^ex(P) − [X_sw^MFP(P) − X_300^MFP(P)] with the MFP results to derive shock‑reduced 300 K isotherms. Output the resulting (element, reduced_volume_X, pressure_GPa) data points for all five metals over the pressure range.
description: Raw shock‑reduced 300 K isotherm data points that the checker refits and uses for pressure consistency verification.
output_schema: Columns: element (str, one of Cu,Ta,Mo,Pt,Au), reduced_volume_X (float), pressure_GPa (float). No header.

title: Fitted universal EOS parameters
action: Fit the shock‑reduced 300 K P‑X data for each metal to the generalized universal EOS to obtain parameters B₀ (GPa), η, β, ξ, δ. Output the fitted parameters.
description: Fitted EOS parameters for each metal; the checker compares these to hidden gold values with tolerances.
output_schema: Columns: element (str), B0 (float, GPa), eta (float), beta (float), xi (float), delta (float).
